method.buildingDimensions: Building.width × depth are parcel-envelope dimensions. The renderer sets structures back and uses kind/profile-specific massing.
method.interpretation: Coverage and FAR are nominal parcel-envelope proxies, not actual rendered building footprint or usable floor area.

denominator: gross area of world.bounds, including water and protected land

statusNotes.occupancy: Resident occupancy is modeled only for homes and apartments. Open shops, cafes, and offices are commercial regardless of the occupancy field.
statusNotes.engineVacancyBehavior: The engine currently treats every open occupancy-zero building as vacant in demand and renewal logic, including commercial buildings; this report does not apply that heuristic.
